verdict.noMarket: No market price for this model's fixtures.

models.noBacktest: This model version has no stored walk-forward backtest.

banner.beating_one: {models} scored better than {baseline} on the {season} test season, with the whole 95% interval below zero. One season is one sample; nothing is promoted automatically.
banner.beating_other: {models} scored better than {baseline} on the {season} test season, with the whole 95% interval below zero. One season is one sample; nothing is promoted automatically.
banner.noneBeating_one: No model beats the market. On {n} test fixtures ({season}), every model has a higher log loss than {baseline}, with the whole 95% interval above zero. All models stay experimental and none feeds a pick.
banner.noneBeating_other: No model beats the market. On {n} test fixtures ({season}), every model has a higher log loss than {baseline}, with the whole 95% interval above zero. All models stay experimental and none feeds a pick.

baseline.title: Market baseline
baseline.subtitle: The bar every model has to clear: bookmaker prices with the margin removed, scored like a model
baseline.overroundNotStored: Two-way market de-vigged on the fly; overround not stored.

quality.title: Predictive quality · 1X2
quality.subtitle: Walk-forward, out of sample. Lower log loss and Brier are better; ECE is calibration error. Accuracy is not a ranking metric.

betting.title: Betting performance
betting.subtitle: Kept apart from predictive quality. A backtest simulation is not a betting record.
betting.empty: No backtest with historical prices has been stored.
betting.fewBets: Fewer than 30 bets: no interval is reported.

leaderboard.noCommon: No common fixtures with the market.

calibration.note: Every outcome of every test fixture, in ten equal-width bins. The dashed diagonal is perfect calibration: below it the model was over-confident in that bin, above it under-confident. ECE {ece}.
calibration.emptyBin: No prediction fell in this bin.

split.empty: No split was stored for this run.

monthly.chartLabel: Monthly log-loss difference against the market
monthly.note: Log loss of the model minus the market, month by month. Above the dashed line the market was better that month. A model that only wins in one month has not shown anything.

markets.oneXTwoOnly: {model} prices 1X2 only: it has no goal distribution.
markets.noOverUnder: No Over/Under comparison was stored for this run.
markets.bttsNoBaseline: No market baseline: the historical source publishes no BTTS prices, so this is scored against outcomes only and cannot be called better or worse than the market.
markets.noBtts: This model does not price BTTS.

shadow.label: Shadow picks
shadow.settled_one: {count} settled at the captured price: ROI
shadow.settled_other: {count} settled at the captured price: ROI
shadow.hitRate: hit rate {hitRate}%. Not a betting record; the breakdown by model is in Performance.

protocol.subtitle: Fixed before the test season was touched
protocol.cutoffValue: {minutes} min before a block's first kick-off
protocol.trainingWindowValue: {days} days, results public 3 h after kick-off
protocol.checks: Every block is checked: a training result not public before the cut-off, or a cut-off not before the kick-off it predicts, stops the run. A test rewrites all later results and requires every earlier prediction to come out identical.

search.notStored: This session stored the chosen values only, not the validation score of every candidate, so the search itself cannot be shown.
search.title: {model} · hyper-parameter search
search.subtitle: Validation log loss on {season}, on the fixtures every candidate predicted. Chosen: ξ={xi}, penalty={penalty}.
search.extended: The best candidate sat on the edge of the initial grid, so the grid was extended by a rule fixed in advance (validation scores only).

rule.title: Decision rule
rule.subtitle: Versioned; a threshold change is a new version

analyst.title: AI analyst
analyst.subtitle: FBI_ANALYST_API_KEY / FBI_ANALYST_MODEL on the API host

notifications.title: Notifications (bot)
notifications.subtitle: Informational only. FBI_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / FBI_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID on the host

recent.title: Recent messages
recent.subtitle: What the bot produced and what happened to each

settings.secrets: Keys and tokens live only on the host. The browser receives whether something is configured, never its value.

v2.title: Research V2 - roles against the market
v2.subtitle: The latest run on the validated history: every forecast's role, with the evidence it was read from. Nothing is promoted automatically.
v2.noRun: No research V2 run has been stored yet.
v2.noneBeats: No model beats the market or adds information to it: qualified picks stay at 0, and every pick stays shadow (evaluation mode).
v2.challengersWait_one: {count} challenger waits for an explicit promotion; until then no pick is qualified.
v2.challengersWait_other: {count} challengers wait for an explicit promotion; until then no pick is qualified.

sections.prospective: Prospective: forecasts stored before kick-off, by segment
sections.audit: Shadow picks: price, edge or luck (E0)

notes.models: Difference = model minus champion log loss on the same fixtures (negative is better), 95% interval over match days. Weight w: what a blend with the market gives the model - above 0 means it adds information. Blend: the validation-fitted weight applied to the test season.
notes.markets: Every de-vigged 1X2 price scored as a forecast on the fixtures all of them priced; the lowest log loss is the champion.
notes.prospective: Since 25 Sep 2026, against the last consensus before kick-off. Grey: too few matches to judge.
notes.audit: Per settled pick (one unit): the claimed EV is the model's; EV at the pick is the price taken against the market's de-vigged view at that moment; movement is how that view changed until the last consensus before kick-off; EV at the close is what the bet was worth then; luck is the realised return minus that. Realised = EV at the pick + movement + luck. Means ± standard error clustered by match; luck's error is the spread it would have if the closing prices were right.

prospective.none: No forecast stored before kick-off has a closing price yet.

legacy.summary_one: {count} run from before the rebuild, kept as it was (LEGACY_RESEARCH_RUN)
legacy.summary_other: {count} runs from before the rebuild, kept as they were (LEGACY_RESEARCH_RUN)
